name: Monika
source:
The level headed leader of the club. It was Monika's love for literature that created the Literature Club as we know it. Conventionally, she really is the model student - intelligent, attractive and athletic. Alongside her presidential duties, she's also a keen tennis player, an aspiring pianist, amongst many other things.

With aspirations that high and this much responsibility, life must be awfully stressful for her...

[Edited from the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/characters.html]official website[/url]]
